text:
Aisha: Ran a 3h stress run on staging w/ 6 tenants; one tenant (T-42) with longctx workloads (avg seq 6k) steadily grows KV memory until OOM on that pod. Paging spikes + eviction churn. Posting perf numbers.
Tom: Can you paste pprof flamegraph or heap profile?
Aisha: Quick heap snapshot shows a lot of small slab allocations and high fragmentation; `kv.page.walks` keeps climbing. Looks like longctx pins many pages and they don't get reclaimed.
Aisha: Sample eviction log:
```
EVICT pod=infra-7 tenant=T-42 reclaimed_pages=48 scan_ms=12 total_pages=512 reason=quota_exceeded
EVICT pod=infra-7 tenant=T-42 reclaimed_pages=0 scan_ms=95 total_pages=520 reason=thrash
```
runtime-bot: eviction-runner triggered for pod infra-7 at 2026-03-17T21:02:13Z — eviction rate ~120/s.
Ben: Hmm. Is this noisy neighbor or a leak? What does `kv.reuse.hit_ratio` look like for T-42 vs others?
Aisha: reuse hit ratio falls to ~4% for T-42 after ~40m of steady load; other tenants stay >45%. That smells like eviction thrash + fragmentation rather than classic leak.
Kira: Could be fragmentation from many long-lived partial pages. Try enabling slab compaction on staging (compact_slab=true) and cap longctx leases.
Tom: Any CPU/regression correlation? We pushed kernel-selection AVX changes 48h ago.
Aisha: Timeline matches. pprof shows hot path in `memcpy` used by kv-defrag routine after kernel-change; memcpy cost up ~20%.
Ben: Proposal: soft per-tenant quota + burst buffer + lease cap for prefix entries. If tenant exceeds `lease_ms=30m` for many prefixes, start migratory eviction.
Kira: Also config a decay LRU per-tenant to avoid a single tenant holding fragmented slabs. Example config: 
```
{
  "tenant_quota_mb": 10240,
  "burst_ratio": 1.5,
  "lease_ms": 1800000,
  "compact_slab": true,
  "decay_factor": 0.7
}
```
Tom: Okay run an A/B: host-A default, host-B with `compact_slab=true` + `decay_factor=0.5`.
Aisha: Started the A/B. Early: host-B paging down ~35%, reuse hit +12%. Fairness still oscillates around 60/20/20.
Ben: If burst buffer helps, add a token-bucket guard for KV allocations so short bursts don't trash resident set.
Kira: Add telemetry: per-tenant resident_pages, reuse_hit_ratio, eviction_rate and a heatmap for slab-fragmentation. We'll need dashboards.
Aisha: I'll push a dashboard PR and attach pprof snapshots to the ticket. Also want to double-check kernel-selection fallback for memcpy kernel; may need to revert micro-optim.
Tom: Thanks. Please file an infra issue with logs + pprofs; I'll triage the kernel change.
Aisha: Filed INF-7891: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-7891 — heap snapshots + pprof + eviction traces attached. cc @Tom @Ben @Kira
runtime-bot: Deploy queued: staging host-B patched with `compact_slab=true` (deploy by dex).
Kira: :thumbsup: We'll reconvene after 24h run and check telemetry. :eyes:
